about_the_game:
Unique Monsters You've Never Seen

For the first time, we're putting traditional Chinese zombies in a VR horror game! These scary, never-stopping monsters will chase you down if they see you, giving you a taste of eerie Eastern horror! Or, if you like classic monsters better, get ready for the sharp teeth of the gargoyle! Plus, there are voodoos, demons, elves, ghosts, mummies, and more waiting to scare you!

 

You Can't Really Die

In this game, you won't die for real! You're a lost soul now. When a monster beats you, you'll turn into a spirit wandering around the museum until you find something else to take control of. Just like a real ghost!

 

Hidden Secrets to Find

Besides the exciting main story, there are lots of hidden secrets in the museum just for you to discover. Some things will only show themselves after you die. These are special stories that you can only unlock by being close to death. Hey, death isn't always bad, right? Make your "death" count!

 

Feel Like in a Real Museum

The game takes place in a private museum full of history. Inside, you'll find tons of old and valuable things from all over the world, and even some magic idols. While you're running away, you can stop and look at all the cool stuff. And, you can even read real books in the museum!

 

Buy Now and Play!Experience this most unique horror game. And, ESCAPE!
